testcase.name: turning away from a clear detonation is the same reduced concussion as cover
each band's durations come straight from the plan
resolve skips the dead and the distant, and reports one hit per player
out of range beats everything: no sight check saves or damns you past the radius
blindness decays from full and clears late rather than fading flatly
no line of sight means a 0.3 s concussion and no slow, even point blank
an opaque smoke volume downgrades a stun through the shared vision query
the stun grenade's radius is the banding radius
a player behind the lane pillar is only concussed
bands split the radius at 30% and 70%
